name: A coffee shop runs its counter on the Stripe Reader S700
object: the Stripe Reader S700, a handheld card-payment terminal, shown through Dripos (an all-in-one POS software built on Stripe) and its customer, a coffee and juice shop
audience: hospitality and retail owners choosing point-of-sale hardware for a counter, a table, or a pop-up
message: This video tells coffee-shop and retail owners that the Stripe Reader S700 is sleek enough to match their brand and mobile enough to follow the order wherever it happens.

moments.what: texture shots of an espresso pull and a latte pour lead into the Dripos founders introducing their all-in-one POS software for coffee shops: point of sale, online and mobile ordering, payroll
moments.copy: It's an all-in-one software for coffee shops: point of sale, online ordering, mobile ordering, payroll, you name it.

moments.what: a map transition from Austin to New York introduces the customer, Revolución Coffee + Juice; its cofounder explains wanting a seamless, frictionless experience for customers
moments.copy: For us it's very important to have a seamless, frictionless experience for the customers.

moments.what: close-ups of the S700 on the counter while staff take an order; the owner describes it as sleek and modernist, and explains pulling it off the counter to open a second register at the table or a pop-up
moments.copy: The new Stripe S700 device, very sleek, minimal modernist design which fits really well with our brand.

moments.what: the owner holds the reader while talking about loyalty, receipts and tipping living on one device; the film closes on a Revolución x Dripos x Stripe logo lockup
moments.copy: It enables us to not have to worry about some of the painful parts of doing payments.

cta: no spoken call to action; the film closes on a co-branded Revolución x Dripos x Stripe logo lockup as an implicit endorsement
why: Pairing tactile close-ups of the device with two real operators vouching for it in their own words lets the hardware's design and flexibility feel proven by daily use, not just claimed in a spec sheet.
